To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the biogas fuel composition has a significant impact on the SOFC performance and that a steam addition to the biogas can prevent carbon deposition and thus improve SOFC operation.
CFD modeling of a planar biogas fuel SOFC unit cell predicts that equimolar biogas leads improved performance and steam addition can prevent the carbon deposition.
the CFD modeling of SOFCs fuelled by equimolar biogas mixtures leads to better performance, and minimal steam addition can avoid carbon deposition.

the mathematical modeling of transport and electrical phenomena in fuel cells.
the development of mathematical models and the use of computational methods to simulate transport and electrochemical processes in SOFCs.
the development of numerical tools and models for the design and optimization of fuel cells.

the CFD modeling of SOFCs can be used as a powerful tool in order to optimize and improve SOFCs performance, as well as to understand and predict the effects of the various operating and design parameters.

the use of biogas as a fuel for SOFCs is feasible and can lead to improved performance, as compared with the use of pure methane.
